$comment: VYRON Repository Safety Programme — environment allowlist.
This file is the authority for Signal 2 (database identity) and Signal 3
(application target identity) of the environment verification model.
IMPORTANT — this file deliberately does NOT resolve the open question recorded
as Unknown 13.1 in the Hardening Plan. Both Supabase project references below
are mapped to 'unknown' because the repository does not establish which one
carries live customer data. That is not an oversight: until an authorised
person resolves it, 'unknown' is the only evidence-based value, and Rule 4
('Unknown is treated as Production') is what keeps execution fail-closed.
TO RESOLVE: change the 'environment' field of the correct entry to
'production' and the other to 'development', set 'unresolved' to false on
both, and record who confirmed it and when in 'confirmedBy'/'confirmedAt'.
This is a reviewed change: it moves the repository from fail-closed to
operational, and it should be approved like a permission change.

bzzlhzgfvnnwxjxvpzdk.evidence: Value of NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL in .env.local (the file all 47 database-touching assets parse). Also recorded as 'connectedDb' in deployment-gap-report.json:26, generated 2026-07-09.

ldnrmgafsquzfitcuvxq.evidence: Documented as the production project in .env.example:13-14 and corroborated by src/supabase/deploy/xero_deployment_baseline.sql:2.

localhost:3007.evidence: Default of NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL in 33 assets; `npm run dev` binds port 3007 per package.json.
localhost:3007.caveat: Identifies the APPLICATION tier only. A local dev server can be pointed at any database, so this must never be read as evidence about the data tier. This is precisely why Signals 2 and 3 must agree independently.

127.0.0.1:3007.caveat: Identifies the APPLICATION tier only. See localhost:3007.

externalTargets.$comment: Signal for the External Integration Gate (Plan Part 5 / Gate 4). An empty list means NO external target is permitted anywhere. Xero demo-company tenant ids are added here in Phase 3, never before.
